title: Indiana Election Night Results — Nov 3, 2026
status_message: Results not yet available — polls close 6 PM ET Nov 3
source_note: Madison Co. Election Summary 8:25 PM ET Nov 3 2026 (preliminary)

us-house.name: Indiana US House delegation
us-house.note: All 9 seats up; all 9 incumbents running. No US Senate race in Indiana in 2026.

in-house.name: Indiana House
in-house.note: 2/3 quorum = 67. All 100 seats up. Democrats need net +4 to break the GOP supermajority.

in-senate.name: Indiana Senate
in-senate.note: 2/3 quorum = 34. 25 of 50 seats up; 25 not up (holdovers).
